text:
Google started a core update on 10 November. It takes up to two weeks to roll out.

So if your website drops from fourth to ninth this week, leave it alone.

The update is still running. Your ranking will move again.

Wait till it settles. Then look at what moved.

Google made over 4,700 changes to search in 2023. Nearly 13 a day.

Nobody can keep up with that. You don't need to.

What Google rewards has barely moved in years. A real business, near the person searching, that clearly does what they typed in.

Work on that every week.

Picture a dental clinic in Morley. It switches on booking in its Facebook lead ads.

Earliest slot on the calendar: three weeks away.

Bookings that week: zero.

People book what's easy. Before you switch booking on, put times in the next few days on your calendar.
